name: Share & Manage Permissions in Google Docs
description: Learn how to share your Google Doc, configure viewer/editor roles, and copy access links.

steps.title: Open Sharing Settings
steps.description: Click the blue 'Share' button in the top-right corner to open document permissions.

action.title: Share Document
action.content: Click the highlighted 'Share' button to open document permissions.

steps.title: Add Collaborators
steps.description: Enter the email addresses of teammates you'd like to collaborate with.

target.css: input[aria-label*='Add' i], input[aria-autocomplete='list'], input[type='email'], input[placeholder*='people' i], input[placeholder*='email' i], [role='combobox'], input#demo-email-input

action.title: Add People or Groups
action.content: Type an email address here to invite a teammate.

steps.title: Copy Document Link
steps.description: Click 'Copy link' to quickly get a direct sharing URL on your clipboard.

target.css: [aria-label*='Copy link' i], [aria-label*='Copy' i], button[aria-label*='Copy' i], [data-tooltip*='Copy' i], #demo-copy-link-btn

action.title: Copy Sharing Link
action.content: Click 'Copy link' to share directly via chat or email.

steps.title: All Set!
steps.description: You've mastered sharing in Google Docs. Collaborators can now access your document securely.

action.title: Sharing Complete!
action.content: You now know how to invite team members and generate sharing links in Google Docs.
